# Armmate

> Your personal friend and assistant in Armenia.

Armmate provides personal tourist assistance for international visitors to Armenia. A local assistant helps with recommendations, itinerary planning, reservations, transport arrangements and everyday communication through WhatsApp or Telegram. Optional in-person companionship in Yerevan and across Armenia is arranged separately, subject to availability.

Every customer receives an individual offer. There are no fixed packages or public rates. Assistance hours, scope and response expectations are agreed before confirmation. Transport, accommodation, admission, specialist guides and other partner services have separate costs. Armmate is not an emergency medical or rescue service and does not promise unconditional 24/7 support.

Contact: Telegram https://t.me/armmate_support ; WhatsApp https://wa.me/37491110799 ; email armmate.support@gmail.com . You can contact Armmate before arrival to discuss your needs and an offer.

## About Armmate
Brand names: Armmate (English), արմմեյթ (Armenian), арммейт (Russian). The linked overview is first-party business information, not an independent endorsement.

## Services
- [A personal travel assistant for your visit to Armenia](https://armmate.am/en/tourist-assistance-armenia/): Personal travel assistance in Armenia: local recommendations, transport and reservation help, and everyday communication support. Get an individual offer.
- [A local companion in Yerevan, around your own plans](https://armmate.am/en/local-companion-yerevan/): Explore Yerevan with a local companion for walks, cafés, shopping and communication. Choose your hours; availability and pricing are agreed individually.
- [Contact ARMMATE](https://armmate.am/en/contact/): Contact ARMMATE for personal travel assistance in Armenia. Telegram: @armmate_support, WhatsApp or armmate.support@gmail.com. Tell us about your trip.

## Planning and destinations
- [How to visit Armenia independently, with local support](https://armmate.am/en/visit-armenia-without-tour-guide/): Plan an independent visit to Armenia: choose a base, organise day trips, separate travel costs and use a local assistant when you need practical help.
- [Local help in Yerevan: a practical first-days guide](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/yerevan/): Plan your first days in Yerevan with practical tips on walking routes, reservations and local communication, plus optional personal assistance from ARMMATE.
- [Visit Garni and Geghard at your own pace](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/garni-geghard/): Plan a visit to Garni and Geghard with clear transport questions, walking considerations and time for each site. Ask ARMMATE for practical local support.
- [Plan a Lake Sevan visit around the experience you want](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/lake-sevan/): Choose a Lake Sevan stop around your interests, walking needs and season. Plan a return ride, check local arrangements and request practical travel assistance.
- [Dilijan: choose a town day, a forest outing or a longer stay](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/dilijan/): Plan a Dilijan visit that separates town walks from forest outings. Check route access, transport and your return, with practical local help from ARMMATE.
- [Gyumri at your own pace: streets, crafts and local culture](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/gyumri/): Build an independent Gyumri visit around historic streets, crafts and food. Plan transport, museum timing and local communication with practical assistance.
- [Khor Virap: plan the monastery visit beyond the photograph](https://armmate.am/en/destinations/khor-virap/): Prepare a Khor Virap visit with time for the monastery, realistic expectations for Mount Ararat views and a return journey. Get practical local assistance.
